title: Security guard George frozen and later hospitalized
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Security guard George frozen and later hospitalized, about 2016-10-14 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Mesa, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah; hospital in Las Vegas

tellings.quote: and he said well when we pulled up and you all jumped out i stood up and was frozen i couldn't move and everything went black

plain: A businessman named Brandon Fugal, who owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah famous for reports of strange happenings, says that around October 2016 a security guard named George had a frightening experience on a raised flat area of the ranch called the mesa. According to Fugal, George said that when the team pulled up and jumped out of the vehicle, he stood up, froze, could not move, and everything went black. Fugal says George later ended up in a hospital in Las Vegas.
